<ul>
<li><strong>真人自然交互</strong>：接话自然、节奏松弛、表达有温度，实时互动更接近真人交流。</li>
<li><strong>听懂话，也听懂话外之音</strong>：理解语气、情绪、副语言线索和环境声音。</li>
<li><strong>真正的全双工对话</strong>：支持自然打断、附和识别和话权协调，不抢话也不装聋。</li>
<li><strong>自适应推理</strong>：简单问题快速回应，复杂问题边想边说，在响应速度和回答质量之间动态平衡。</li>
<li><strong>从会聊天到能办事</strong>：Voice Agent 可调用工具或执行后端任务，任务完成后自然回到对话。</li>
</ul>

<ul>
<li><strong>真人级说话表现</strong>：在音色、语调、节奏和气口停顿上贴近自然口语，可呈现笑声、迟疑、结巴、重复和改口等真实表达。</li>
<li><strong>超低时延流式生成</strong>：支持边生成边输出，适合实时对话和语音助手。</li>
<li><strong>高表现力控制</strong>：支持从整体语境到局部表达的细致控制，适合有声内容、配音和情绪化播报。</li>
</ul>

<ul>
<li><strong>综合音频内容创作</strong>：用自然语言描述角色设定、音色风格和情绪表达，即可生成富有表现力、可精细控制的人声，并统一编排音效、环境音、背景音乐与歌声。</li>
<li><strong>精细化声音设计与控制</strong>：支持通过自然语言控制多角色台词、音色风格、说话方式、语气情绪、方言口音，以及笑声、喘息、停顿等副语言特征，可在一条指令中描述多个角色及其互动关系。</li>
<li><strong>全要素生成与时序编排</strong>：可指定人声、音效、环境音和背景音乐的出现位置与先后顺序，完成协同生成与片段衔接。</li>
<li><strong>专业内容生产</strong>：适用于影视、游戏、动画、广播剧和有声书等场景，快速完成角色配音、多角色对白及配套的环境音、音效和背景音乐。</li>
<li><strong>短视频与自媒体</strong>：无需专业音频制作经验，一段规范化的自然语言描述即可生成风格可控的配音，并按需补充背景音乐和音效。</li>
</ul>

<ul>
<li><strong>语境理解</strong>：以大语言模型为语义底座，结合音频、上下文和领域知识，提升专业术语、人名和同音词识别。</li>
<li><strong>跨语言、跨场景提升</strong>：覆盖中文、英文、方言、中英混说、长音频和垂类领域。</li>
<li><strong>复杂声音处理</strong>：支持悄悄话、极快语速、含糊连读、环境噪声、歌唱和背景音乐。</li>
<li><strong>低误识别</strong>：无语音测试准确率达到 99%，减少环境声、背景音乐和静音片段的误转写。</li>
<li><strong>评测亮点</strong>：内部上下文推理错误率 0.57%，较 StepAudio 2.5 ASR 降低 64.2%；AISHELL-6 悄悄话 CER 为 3.97%。</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">关于 StepAudio 2.5 系列的对话模型，我们提供了两种不同的方式调用最新的语音对话模型，分别对应 StepAudio 2.5 Realtime 和 StepAudio 2.5 Chat：</span>
<ul>
<li>StepAudio 2.5 Realtime，支持实时语音对话的 Realtime 交互形式，使用 websocket 协议，支持语音请求、语音回复，便于直接使用我们封装好的一整套实时对话能力使用。</li>
<li>StepAudio 2.5 Chat，支持按轮次对话的 Chat Comletion 交互形式，支持单次提交语音请求、流式文本输出回复内容，便于基于接口和模型能力进行接入和开发。</li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="stepaudio-2-5-tts"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="导航到标题" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#stepaudio-2-5-tts">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">StepAudio 2.5 TTS</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">Contextual TTS，真正具有声音表演能力的语音合成模型。首次将<strong>语境理解能力</strong>引入语音生成全流程，让 AI 不是念文本，而是演文本。支持<strong>通过自然语言描述实现全局语境定调与句中细腻控制</strong>，生成具有呼吸感、轻重主次、情绪弧线的真人级表达。</span>
<ol>
<li><strong>双档语境控制，人人都是配音导演</strong>：<!-- -->
<ul>
<li>通过 Global Context（全局语境）+ Inline Context（文中语境）双档控制，既能为整段内容定调氛围和人物关系，也能逐句精控每个字词如何演绎。</li>
<li>告别传统标签匹配，用自然语言描述你想要的声音表达。情绪、风格、场景、说话状态，模型都能理解并精准执行。</li>
<li>支持「克制的悲伤，不哭腔，轻轻发颤」「试探着撒娇，不是很黏，带一点嘴硬」这类复杂、混合、有层次的表达意图，实现更开放、更连续、也更贴近真实语境的情绪控制。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>Zero-shot Clone 全音色可控，百变音色随心复刻</strong>：<!-- -->
<ul>
<li>只需 3s 参考音频即可进行音色复刻，且完整继承全局 / 文中语境控制能力，不受固定音库和预设角色的限制。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>字字有戏，句句真实，开口没有 AI 味</strong>：<!-- -->
<ul>
<li>在停顿、重音、节奏、语气转折等韵律维度上全面提升，合成语音有呼吸感、有轻重主次、有情绪起伏。</li>
<li>底层人声品质升级，输出的声音更通透、更具拟人感，没有传统语音合成常见的“塑料感”和“AI 味”。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<span data-as="p">有声书、短剧配音、广告旁白、情感叙事、内容二创等多种对语音表现力有高要求的场景。</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="stepaudio-2-5-asr"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="导航到标题" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#stepaudio-2-5-asr">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">StepAudio 2.5 ASR</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">阶跃新一代语音识别模型，4B 参数 + Multi-Token Prediction（MTP）架构。在保持 SOTA 转写精度的同时单步并行预测多个 Token，大幅削减串行等待——5 分钟音频可在 1 秒内完成转写。提供一次性提交（SSE，模型字符串 <code>stepaudio-2.5-asr</code>）与实时双向流式（WebSocket，模型字符串 <code>stepaudio-2.5-asr-stream</code>）两种接入方式。</span>
<ol>
<li><strong>极速推理，吞吐与时延双线突破</strong>：<!-- -->
<ul>
<li>引入 MTP 技术单步并行预测多个 Token，吞吐量较传统 ASR 提升 400%，时延降低 60%。</li>
<li>引擎侧 RTF ≈ 0.0053，转写 1 小时音频约需 19 秒，5 分钟音频 1 秒内出完整结果。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>SOTA 转写精度，多场景全面刷新基线</strong>：<!-- -->
<ul>
<li>基于 4B 参数深度优化，在新闻、会议、强噪声等多场景下，中英文错误率全面刷新行业基线。</li>
<li>支持 ITN 文本规范化，转写结果可直接用于业务系统。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>进阶识别能力</strong>：<!-- -->
<ul>
<li>双向流式（<code>stepaudio-2.5-asr-stream</code>）支持累计全量文本、可纠错尾词与字级时间戳，适合实时对话、语音助手、会议字幕。</li>
<li>音频文件识别支持分句与字 / 词级时间戳、双声道分轨，以及说话人识别（区分同一段音频中的不同说话人）。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>极致性价比，Step Plan 直接可用</strong>：<!-- -->
<ul>
<li>一次性提交（SSE）API 定价 0.15 元 / 小时，仅为上代 <code>step-asr</code> 系列的 1/10；双向流式 1.2 元 / 小时。</li>
<li>Step Plan 订阅用户可直接调用，无需额外开通。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<span data-as="p">Voice Agent、大规模批量转写、实时字幕 / 直播、会议记录、语音输入等对识别速度与准确率均有要求的场景。</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="step-audio-2"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="导航到标题" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#step-audio-2">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Step Audio 2</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>定位：全方位感官理解与端到端自然交互</li>
<li>能力标签：音色复刻、Tool Call、网络搜索</li>
<li>体验入口：<a class="link" href="https://www.stepfun.com/studio/audio?tab=voice-chat" rel="noreferrer" target="_blank">体验中心</a></li>
<li>在语言方面能够理解中文普通话、中文方言、英语、日语。支持语音复刻（通过上传音色片段实现自定义音色）。在能力方面能够理解环境声音事件、人类副语言和语音中的情绪、根据声音推测用户年龄、理解音乐，能够控制不同的语速、语调和情感进行表达，具备原生的 Tool Call 和 网络搜索 能力。</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="step-audio-2-mini"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="导航到标题" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#step-audio-2-mini">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Step Audio 2 Mini</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>定位：轻盈、极速而又不失深度</li>
<li>能力标签：Tool Call、网络搜索</li>
<li>接入方式：仅支持 API 接入</li>
<li>与 <code>step-audio-2</code> 模型相似，原生的 Tool Call 和网络搜索能力，效果得分在指令遵循、数理和推理任务上略低于 <code>step-audio-2</code>。模型推理速度更快，需要的资源更少。</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="stepaudio-2-asr-pro"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="导航到标题" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#stepaudio-2-asr-pro">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">StepAudio 2 ASR Pro</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">32B 参数的 ASR Pro 模型。</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="step-audio-r1-5"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="导航到标题" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#step-audio-r1-5">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Step Audio R1.5</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>定位：深度声音理解与推理（Step Audio R1.1 升级版）</li>
<li>能力标签：边说边想、深度推理、自然交互</li>
<li>体验入口：<a class="link" href="https://www.stepfun.com/studio/audio?tab=conversation" rel="noreferrer" target="_blank">体验中心</a></li>
<li>在 Step Audio R1.1 的基础上升级，进一步强化声音细节分析与逻辑推理能力，能听懂语气背后的深意，大幅提高对声音和情绪的理解。</li>
<li>引入基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF），在保持推理能力的同时，提升长程语音对话的自然度与情感连贯性。</li>
<li>推理和说话并发进行，在保证高质量回复的同时实现更快响应。</li>
</ul>

<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="step-1o-audio"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="导航到标题" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#step-1o-audio">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Step-1o Audio</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>定位：稳定型，久经考验</li>
<li>能力标签：Tool Call</li>
<li>接入方式：仅支持 API 接入</li>
<li>第一代 端到端语音模型。技术成熟稳定，在汽车场景下大规模部署，久经考验，支持多种预置音色风格，支持工具调用。适用于构建基础的语音交互、内容生成等常规业务场景。</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p"><strong>应用案例</strong></span>
<ul>
<li>
<span data-as="p"><strong>情感陪伴场景</strong>：在用户分享人生重要时刻时，如相亲成功经历，模型能够表达恰当的祝贺，提出深入问题，并展现真实的情感共鸣。</span>
<!-- -->
</li>
<li>
<span data-as="p"><strong>安全驾驶辅助</strong>：识别驾驶者疲劳状态下的语音特征，给予针对性的安全建议，同时通过情感支持缓解疲劳感。</span>
<!-- -->
</li>
<li>
<span data-as="p"><strong>方言交互能力</strong>：精准模拟地方方言特性，如四川话的音调起伏和特色词汇运用，提供本地化的语音交互体验。</span>
<!-- -->
</li>
<li>
<span data-as="p"><strong>如何与男朋友撒娇</strong>：以自然可爱且略带俏皮的语气，示范与亲密关系间的撒娇互动，增强关系亲密度。</span>
<!-- -->
</li>
<li>
<span data-as="p"><strong>亲子关系支持</strong>：针对家长首次送孩子入学等敏感场景，理解并安抚焦虑情绪，同时提供实用的适应性建议。</span>
<!-- -->
</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="step-tts-2"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="导航到标题" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#step-tts-2">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Step TTS 2</span></h3>
<span data-as="p"><code>step-tts-mini</code> 的升级版：极简高效设计摒弃传统 speaker/emotion 嵌入模块，通过纯 NTP 实现端到端语音生成，大幅降低系统复杂度。支持 <code>step-tts-mini</code> 全部音色、情绪、风格、语种，并在其基础上，进一步强化<strong>情绪与风格的可控度</strong>、<strong>情绪表现力</strong> 和<strong>音色复刻效果</strong>。</span>
<ol>
<li><strong>11 种情绪 17种风格 3种语言精准可控，情绪饱满，韵律自然，表现力强</strong>：<!-- -->
<ul>
<li>内置 11 种情绪 与 17 种风格 控制，覆盖从温柔甜美到严肃豪爽的多样化表达。语气、韵律与停连更贴近真人情绪起伏。</li>
<li>完美适配需要情绪张力的配音与对话。</li>
<li>支持粤语、四川话、日语。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>10s 音频，精准复刻，0成本支持全部情绪风格控制</strong>：<!-- -->
<ul>
<li>仅需约 10 秒参考音频，即可精准复刻音色，并零成本激活全部情绪与风格控制；</li>
<li>适合需要用复刻后的音色 + 多情绪播报的场景，如短视频配音、情感陪聊、营销播报等。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li><strong>音色复刻支持口音精准还原</strong>：<!-- -->
<ul>
<li>领先的 LLM-based 架构，相较同类产品，可提供对说话人口音细节更精准的复刻效果。</li>
<li>为 <strong>直播带货</strong> 场景提供更加真实、自然的语音交互体验，有效提升观众沉浸感和信任度。让虚拟主播或智能话术如同真人般亲切生动，显著降低用户听觉疲劳，助力转化率提升。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="step-tts-mini"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="导航到标题" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#step-tts-mini">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Step TTS Mini</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">强大的文本转语音模型，以高情绪表现力和风格可控性为亮点。</span>
<ol>
<li><strong>11 种情绪、7种风格、3种语言可控</strong>：内置 9 种情绪 与 13 种风格 控制；支持粤语、四川话、日语。</li>
<li><strong>10s 音频，精准复刻，0成本支持全部情绪风格控制</strong>：仅需约 10 秒参考音频，即可精准复刻音色，并零成本激活全部情绪与风格控制。复刻相似度业界领先。</li>
</ol>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="step-asr"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="导航到标题" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#step-asr">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Step ASR</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">阶跃自动语音识别模型，支持实时与离线识别，具备高准确率与低延迟。</span>
<span data-as="p">特点：</span>
<ul>
<li>支持中英文及多种方言；</li>
<li>可应用于语音转写、会议记录、客服质检、语音搜索等场景。</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">阶跃自动语音识别模型，适用于音频文件识别场景。</span>
<span data-as="p">特点：</span>
<ul>
<li>可应用于语音转写、会议记录、客服质检、语音搜索等场景。</li>
</ul>

<span data-as="p">阶跃自动语音识别模型，适用于流式语音识别场景。</span>
<span data-as="p">特点：</span>
<ul>
<li>适用于实时语音输入与流式文本返回场景。</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="使用限制"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a aria-label="导航到标题" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" href="#使用限制">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0" fill="none" height="18" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" viewbox="0 0 18 18" width="18" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" linecap="round" linejoin="round" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="min-w-0 break-words cursor-pointer">使用限制</span></h2>
<ol>
<li><strong>单次请求支持的最大字符数</strong>：tts 模型单次最多支持输入 1000 个字符。</li>
<li><strong>输出格式</strong>：支持 wav、mp3、flac、opus，默认为 mp3 格式。</li>
<li><strong>StepAudio 3 Gen 输入限制</strong>：<code>instruction</code> 和 <code>roles</code> 字段最多 500 字符，<code>scripts</code> 字段最多 1000 字符；超出限制时接口返回 HTTP 400。</li>
<li><strong>StepAudio 3 Gen 返回方式</strong>：当前支持 HTTP <code>audio</code> / <code>sse</code> 返回，不支持 WebSocket 双向流式。</li>
</ol>
